newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five workers die in Manila elevator crash.
newsitem.headline: Five workers die in Manila elevator crash.

text.p: Five Filipino workers were killed on Thursday when an elevator they were installing in a high-rise building in Manila's Makati business district crashed 100 feet down, police said.
Investigators said the workers were apparently testing the elevator at the apartment building under construction when it plunged from the sixth floor, killing all its five occupants.
Police were investigating what caused the crash.
They said the accident happened at the Kingswood Twin Tower apartment building under construction on Vito Cruz street.
